config.name: Demo Café
config.owner_preferences: Keep the dining room comfortable during dinner service.

catalog.name: HVAC
catalog.source_note: One 5-ton packaged RTU (PSZ-AC, gas furnace), per unit: DX compressor ~5.45 kW (60 kBtu/h / EER 11) + share of the constant ventilation fans. Sized on NREL ComStock bldg 5847 upgrade 45 (2018): HVAC = cooling + fans + heating (ComStock's electric HVAC group, 74,322 kWh/yr); fans are a constant 5.739 kW (night_fanon_vent); worst 15-min block 15.714 kW (2018-06-23 18:45) = 7.857 kW per unit for 2 units, so 8.0 kW covers the whole year without clipping. 40 % min = 3.2 kW >= the 2.87 kW ventilation fan share per unit. derived

catalog.name: Walk-in cooler
catalog.source_note: Modeled walk-in condensing load; ENERGY STAR V5 explicitly excludes walk-ins, so this is a transparent demo assumption rather than an ENERGY STAR rating.

catalog.name: Reach-in fridge
catalog.source_note: Modeled two-door reach-in input; duty behavior is calibrated to ENERGY STAR commercial refrigerator daily-energy criteria, not a claimed product rating.

catalog.name: Freezer
catalog.source_note: Modeled reach-in freezer input; duty behavior is calibrated to ENERGY STAR commercial freezer daily-energy criteria, not a claimed product rating.

catalog.name: Ice machine
catalog.source_note: Modeled batch ice-machine input; cycle length and draw are explicit demo assumptions informed by ENERGY STAR commercial ice-machine test criteria.

catalog.name: Fryer
catalog.source_note: Modeled standard electric fryer; ENERGY STAR defines electric idle rate <=0.8 kW, while the intentionally conservative 1.5 kW demo idle represents a non-certified baseline.

catalog.name: Oven
catalog.source_note: Modeled full-size electric convection oven input; values are explicit demo assumptions informed by FSTC ASTM-standard appliance testing.

catalog.name: Grill
catalog.source_note: Modeled electric griddle input; rated draw is aligned with published FSTC-tested electric griddle cooking rates near 8.9 kW.

catalog.name: Dishwasher
catalog.source_note: Modeled high-temperature door-type dishwasher including booster demand; draw and batch length are explicit demo assumptions informed by ENERGY STAR commercial dishwasher criteria.

catalog.name: Water heater
catalog.source_note: Modeled single-element electric water-heater input; rated draw and duty cycle are explicit demo assumptions informed by DOE commercial water-heater test procedures.

catalog.name: Lights
catalog.source_note: Modeled 2,500 ft² restaurant at 0.96 W/ft²; explicit demo assumption within ASHRAE 90.1 restaurant lighting-power-density ranges.
